ModMetaData.name: D'thorga Vehicles
ModMetaData.author: Phobos A. D'thorga
ModMetaData.description:
Vehicles that keep running only while they are looked after. This first version adds no vehicles of its own: it fits the vehicles of other mods you already drive with the right systems for what they really are.
What it does now:
- Heavy trucks with air brakes (Vanilla Vehicles Expanded's Big Rig, RimThunder's HEMTT) must idle a few minutes to build air before they can drive. - The Humvee runs a 24-volt electrical system with two batteries. - Tanks with gas-turbine engines (RimThunder's M1A2) have no radiator: their engines are air-cooled. - Steam locomotives (Trains of the Rim) are left as they are, since a boiler is not a car engine.
Every other vehicle gets the general systems D'thorga Framework gives by what the vehicle runs on: battery and alternator, coolant and oil, tyres or tracks, brakes, gearbox, wear and service. Utility vehicles of our own (a survey truck, a drill rig, a tipper, a generator) come later.
Needs Vehicle Framework and D'thorga Framework. Safe to add to a running colony. Safe to remove: the named vehicles go back to the general systems.
